title: A Probe Landed on a Comet, Then Bounced Off It for Hours

scenes.text: A probe landed on a comet. Then it bounced away.
In November 2014, Europe's Philae lander dropped onto comet 67P.
The harpoons meant to anchor it never fired.
In the comet's tiny gravity, it bounced back up and drifted for about a kilometre.
Two hours after first touching down, it finally came to rest. Three touchdowns in one day.
It landed beside a cliff, in shadow, yet still sent back data for about two and a half days.

description:
A probe landed on a comet, then bounced away.
Philae's anchoring harpoons failed, so it bounced and touched down three times in one day.
Would you have tried a comet landing?
first_comment: Three touchdowns in one day on a comet. What would you name the lander?
